commentary.text: 90+8' That's the end of the match.
90+7' Michael Kayode (Brentford) fancies his chances and unleashes a powerful shot from the edge of the box, but the keeper just watches it go high over the bar.
90+5' Chris Kavanagh shows a yellow card to Vitaly Janelt (Brentford) for his blatant foul.
90+4' Bart Verbruggen (Brighton) is given a fully deserved yellow card.
90+4' Igor Thiago (Brentford) blows a huge chance to score! He sends the penalty to the bottom left corner, but it's not enough to beat Bart Verbruggen who easily stops the effort.
90+4' Igor Thiago (Brentford) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
90+3' The penalty decision stands after the VAR review. It's a penalty!
90+3' The referee isn't 100% sure if it's a penalty to Brentford, he's going to review using VAR.

90+3' One of the Brighton players commits a holding foul and the referee reaches for his whistle. PENALTY to Brentford! Almost the entire opposition team is gathered around the referee and complaining. However, the decision has been made and it's final.
90+1' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Brajan Gruda (Brighton) was quite harsh and Chris Kavanagh didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
90+1' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
89' Fabian Hurzeler has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Joel Veltman (Brighton) replacing Georginio Rutter.
89' The manager makes a subsitution with Brajan Gruda (Brighton) coming on for Yankuba Minteh.
87' The ball is cleared after Igor Thiago (Brentford) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
86' Kevin Schade (Brentford) jumps high after collecting a perfect cross and strikes with a bullet header! His effort goes miles wide of the left post. Poor header!

84' 2 - 1 Goal! Jack Hinshelwood (Brighton) picks up the ball from a rebound and from the edge of the box he unleashes a low shot into the bottom right corner. Caoimhin Kelleher is unable to keep the ball out of the net. It's 2:1.
84' Yankuba Minteh (Brighton) bursts past a couple of players and shoots from the edge of the box, but his shot is blocked.
83' Brentford players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
80' Substitution. Mathias Jensen (Brentford) in, Yegor Yarmolyuk out.
80' Keith Andrews has decided to substitute Kristoffer Ajer and he is replaced by Aaron Hickey (Brentford).
80' A substitution has been made. Mikkel Damsgaard goes off and Vitaly Janelt (Brentford) comes on.
79' Mats Wieffer (Brighton) was too forceful with his tackle and Chris Kavanagh interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
78' Ferdi Kadioglu (Brighton) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
78' Maxim De Cuyper (Brighton) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
77' Georginio Rutter (Brighton) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
76' Michael Kayode (Brentford) receives a diagonal pass, bursts into the box and shoots towards the middle of the goal. Bart Verbruggen is well positioned, though, and it's a comfortable save.

73' That's unlucky! Ferdi Kadioglu (Brighton) picks up the ball within his own half and goes on a mazy run before shooting from distance. The ball looks in all the way but curls at the last second and flies just wide of the left post.
71' 1 - 1 It's 1:1! Yankuba Minteh feeds Danny Welbeck (Brighton) inside the box, who is unmarked and buries the ball in the bottom right corner.
71' The ratio of the ball possession is 67:33.
70' It is time for a substitution. Jack Hinshelwood (Brighton) is on for Diego Gomez.
69' A cross from a corner kick by Brighton is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
69' Yankuba Minteh (Brighton) goes on a mazy run through the defence and gets within shooting range inside the box, but his effort under the crossbar is thwarted by Caoimhin Kelleher.
66' Ferdi Kadioglu (Brighton) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.

66' Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford) receives a clever pass and shoots from mid-range. His shot looks like it's going in the middle of the goal, but Bart Verbruggen has other ideas and makes a brilliant save.
65' Substitution. Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Dango Ouattara walks off.
64' That will be a yellow card for one of the players. The one who gets booked is Diego Gomez (Brighton).
64' Kevin Schade (Brentford) sends a precise pass into the box, but Dango Ouattara loses the one-on-one with the defender.
62' Dango Ouattara (Brentford) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
62' Kevin Schade (Brentford) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
59' Brighton failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

58' Ferdi Kadioglu (Brighton) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Brighton.
56' Great chance! Danny Welbeck (Brighton) picks up a rebound inside the box, cuts inside his marker but rifles his shot high over the bar.
55' Dango Ouattara (Brentford) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball.
54' Maxim De Cuyper (Brighton) sprays a pass out to Ferdi Kadioglu, but he can't beat his man to get to the ball.
52' Yankuba Minteh (Brighton) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted.
51' Dango Ouattara (Brentford) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.
49' Brighton enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
47' Brighton take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
46' Fabian Hurzeler has made a change at the break. Lewis Dunk (Brighton) has come on in place of Olivier Boscagli.
46' The game is over for Carlos Baleba. Maxim De Cuyper (Brighton) comes on for the second half.
46' The whistle blows and Chris Kavanagh starts the second half.
45+5' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.

45+4' Georginio Rutter (Brighton) holds his head in his hands after wasting a promising chance. He latches onto a rebound, creates some space for himself and fires the ball from the edge of the box into the stands.
45+3' The free kick into the penalty area from Yasin Ayari (Brighton) is cleared.
45+2' Brighton will take a corner kick.
45+1' Georginio Rutter (Brighton) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.
45' 4 additional min. will be played.
44' Igor Thiago (Brentford) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
42' Igor Thiago (Brentford) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.

41' What a wasted opportunity by Georginio Rutter (Brighton)! He creates some space for himself inside the penalty box and unleashes a decent strike towards the middle of the net, but Caoimhin Kelleher makes a comfortable save to thwart him.
39' Yankuba Minteh (Brighton) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
38' Danny Welbeck (Brighton) wastes a big opportunity. He shoots from the free kick just outside the box, but his poor effort goes well over the crossbar.
36' It's like he was asking for a caution. Dango Ouattara (Brentford) receives a yellow card.

33' What an opportunity! Yegor Yarmolyuk (Brentford) picked the ball up and fired a projectile of a shot from long range which threatened the goalkeeper. The shot went painfully close to the right post!
32' The resulting set piece from Brentford is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
29' 0 - 1 Goal! Igor Thiago (Brentford) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Bart Verbruggen into the bottom left corner.
29' Igor Thiago (Brentford) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
29' The penalty decision stands after the VAR review. It's a penalty!
28' Hang on! It might not be a penalty for Brentford as the ref now wants to review using VAR. This hopefully won't take too long.
28' Carlos Baleba (Brighton) tackles a bit over-zealously and Chris Kavanagh blows for a foul. Brentford are given a huge opportunity to score - it's a penalty kick!

25' Georginio Rutter (Brighton) does well to control a poor pass on the edge of the box then shoots towards the bottom left corner. Caoimhin Kelleher is out of position but leaps to make a brilliant save.
22' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Igor Thiago (Brentford) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
21' Danny Welbeck (Brighton) latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box, but miskicks his shot and the ball goes high over the bar. Poor effort!
18' A cross into the box from Michael Kayode (Brentford) is cleared.
18' The ball is out of play. Brentford win a corner kick.
17' The free kick is delivered by Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared.

16' A clumsy foul by Olivier Boscagli (Brighton) and Chris Kavanagh blows his whistle. The referee gives a penalty to Brentford after a quick talk with the linesman, who had apparently seen the situation from a better perspective.
15' Olivier Boscagli (Brighton) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Chris Kavanagh had an easy-decision to make.
15' Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
13' Brentford spell of possession comes to an end after a mistake.
11' Danny Welbeck (Brighton) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.

10' Georginio Rutter (Brighton) was the quickest one to orientate himself inside the box and leaps to connect with a cross from the corner kick. He produces a fine header, but it flies narrowly wide of the left post.
9' Yankuba Minteh (Brighton) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
9' A pass into the box finds Mats Wieffer (Brighton) unmarked. He carefully places a shot towards the right side of the goal, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Caoimhin Kelleher denies him.
9' Yegor Yarmolyuk (Brentford) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
7' Georginio Rutter (Brighton) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
6' Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
5' Mats Wieffer (Brighton) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Chris Kavanagh stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
4' A rebound sits up perfectly for Yegor Yarmolyuk (Brentford), who connects nicely with the ball from mid-range but sends it miles wide of the right post.
4' Nathan Michael Collins (Brentford) meets the free kick and unleashes a header from the edge of the box, but it's not powerful enough to trouble Bart Verbruggen.
2' Dango Ouattara (Brentford) tries to find Igor Thiago with a clever through ball from the corner of the box, but the defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Brentford will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Chris Kavanagh.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
